_what: How a person's writing voice is kept (read-data/voice.mjs, moved from Trillion-X/trillion src/voice.mjs). Two record types: an edit (what the person changed in words an AI wrote: before and after, kept the moment they change a draft) and a profile (what an AI has learned about how this person writes, as the named fields below). Everything that varies is a row here: the types, the sizes, the profile's fields, the words an AI is told. A field is added or removed by editing `profile_fields`; nothing in code names one. `sent` names the records whose words the person sent (their newest `scan` records of `type` whose status is `status`, the words in `text_field`). `repeated` is the fewest different drafts a word change must recur in to be shown as repeated.

profile_fields.label: How they write
profile_fields.description: In their own terms: length, warmth, directness, how they open and close.

profile_fields.label: Words and phrases they use
profile_fields.description: Words, phrases and spellings they reach for or put in when they change a draft.

profile_fields.label: Words and phrases they take out
profile_fields.description: What they delete or replace when they edit a draft.

profile_fields.label: Their own lines to copy
profile_fields.description: Short lines from what they wrote or sent that sound most like them.

profile_fields.label: Profiles it builds on
profile_fields.description: The kinds of the profiles this one sits on, earliest first, such as a base everyone is held to, then a market or kind of reader, then a company or team. Read those first; this profile's fields override theirs field by field.

words.how_to_use: Write the way this person writes. Read profiles first, then the edits: each edit is an AI's draft (before) beside the words the person changed it to (after). After drafting, if their edits show something the profile lacks, save it with tool:save-voice. Sent shows words they published. A profile's builds_on names the profiles it sits on: read them first, earliest first, and let each later one override. tool:find-repeated-voice-edits shows the word changes their edits repeat.
words.no_profile: No profile is saved yet. Learn from the edits and sent words below, then save one with tool:save-voice.
words.stale: This profile was saved again at {set_at}, not at {expected}, since you read it. Read it again with tool:read-voice and edit from what it shows now.
words.unknown_field: {field} is not a field of a voice profile. The fields are: {fields}.
words.too_many_profiles: An account keeps at most {max} voice profiles, one for each kind of writing. Save into one that exists, or forget one first.
words.bad_kind: kind is a short lower-case name for what is written (like post or email), at most 40 letters, digits and dashes.
words.nothing_named: Name what to forget: profile_id, edit_id, or all_edits true.
words.repeat_minimum: min_distinct_drafts is a whole number of at least 2: one draft never makes a pattern.
words.repeated: These word changes recur across different drafts the person edited. They are proposals: show them to the person before saving any into a profile.
words.none_repeated: No word change recurs in enough different drafts yet.
